outline: Biomaterials is an introductory course designed for biomaterial compositions, manufacture, functionality and implant ability. Biomaterials included in the course are sutures, vascular grafts, artificial organs, artificial tissues, etc. In addition, biocompatibility, biodegradability, carcinogenicity and toxicity of biomaterials are presented in detail.
